asks: Do you know what I'm for? Nobody has, yet.
Would you move me? I would rather you did not, but you may.
description: A box of black glass the length of a forearm sits exactly in the middle of where it is, catching the light in a single hard line. It's the most important object you have ever seen and you have no idea what it's for.
emotes: The line of light along {it} moves, though nothing in the room has.
{it} sits in the exact middle of everything, and everything arranges itself around it.
For a moment {it} is warm to look at, the way a lit window is warm.
looks: Placed. Not left. Placed, and every decision about it was correct.
It has weight the way a word has meaning. Lifting it would be a whole afternoon.
There's something inside it, and the glass is exactly dark enough that you'll never know what.
name: a reliquary of black glass
says: I have been here longer than the room.
Somebody stood exactly where you're standing, for a very good reason.
Nothing is required of you. Nothing has been for a while.
